purpose: Condemn behavior as unacceptable for someone in a role.
keywords: V dictionary + まじき + N; する → する / すまじき
It was a remark unworthy of a teacher.
It is conduct that must not be tolerated in public.
That attitude is unacceptable for someone in charge.
formation: V dictionary + まじき + N; する → する / すまじき
restrictions: Often follows a role marked by にある.
mistake: まじき modifies a noun and is not an everyday prohibition ending.
